components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one filled action per view (Exporter): deep blue under white text.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; height:28px; padding:0 10px; font:500 12px/1 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; color:#fff; background:var(--color-accent-strong, #0a6fcc); border:0; border-radius:4px; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 100ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:#0b7ee6; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--color-accent, #0d99ff); outline-offset:1px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity:.4; pointer-events:none; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Neutral filled action on raised graphite.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { height:28px; padding:0 10px; font:500 12px/1 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; color:var(--color-ink, #e6e6e6); background:var(--color-raised, #383838); border:0; border-radius:4px; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 100ms; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background:var(--color-line-strong, #4a4a4a); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--color-accent, #0d99ff); outline-offset:1px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Low-emphasis action; fill appears only on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { height:28px; padding:0 10px; font:500 12px/1 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; color:var(--color-ink-muted, #b8b8b8); background:transparent; border:0; border-radius:4px; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 100ms, color 100ms; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { color:var(--color-ink, #e6e6e6); background:var(--color-hover, #333333); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--color-accent, #0d99ff); outline-offset:1px; }

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: Recessed track of equal options; the active one rises to raised graphite.
components.css: .ds-seg { display:inline-flex; padding:2px; border-radius:6px; background:var(--color-canvas, #1e1e1e); } .ds-seg-opt { height:28px; padding:0 10px; font:400 12px/1 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; color:var(--color-ink-muted, #b8b8b8); background:transparent; border:0; border-radius:4px; cursor:pointer; transition:color 100ms, background-color 100ms; } .ds-seg-opt:hover { color:var(--color-ink, #e6e6e6); } .ds-seg-opt.is-active { background:var(--color-raised, #383838); color:var(--color-ink, #e6e6e6); font-weight:500; } .ds-seg-opt:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--color-accent, #0d99ff); outline-offset:1px; }

components.name: Number Field
components.description: Recessed canvas field with inline faint prefix and tabular right-aligned value.
components.css: .ds-field { display:flex; align-items:center; width:120px; height:28px; border-radius:4px; background:var(--color-canvas, #1e1e1e); border:1px solid transparent; } .ds-field:hover { border-color:var(--color-line-strong, #4a4a4a); } .ds-field:focus-within { border-color:var(--color-accent, #0d99ff); } .ds-field-pre { padding:0 4px 0 8px; font:400 11px Inter, ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; color:var(--color-ink-faint, #9a9a9a); } .ds-field-in { flex:1; min-width:0; padding-right:8px; font:400 12px Inter, ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; text-align:right; color:var(--color-ink, #e6e6e6); background:transparent; border:0; outline:none; caret-color:var(--color-accent, #0d99ff); }

components.name: Slider Field
components.description: Label and editable formatted value over a 2px blue-filled track with a white thumb.
components.html: Capacité visée69 892 places
components.css: .ds-slider { width:268px; font:400 12px Inter, ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; } .ds-slider-head { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; color:var(--color-ink-muted, #b8b8b8); } .ds-slider-val { color:var(--color-ink, #e6e6e6); font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; } .ds-range { appearance:none; width:100%; height:16px; margin-top:4px; background:transparent; cursor:pointer; } .ds-range::-webkit-slider-runnable-track { height:2px; border-radius:1px; background:linear-gradient(to right, var(--color-accent, #0d99ff) var(--fill), var(--color-line-strong, #4a4a4a) var(--fill)); } .ds-range::-webkit-slider-thumb { appearance:none; width:12px; height:12px; margin-top:-5px; border-radius:50%; background:#fff; box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / .5); transition:transform 120ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-range:hover::-webkit-slider-thumb { transform:scale(1.2); } .ds-range:focus-visible { outline:none; } .ds-range:focus-visible::-webkit-slider-thumb { transform:scale(1.2); box-shadow:0 0 0 3px var(--color-accent-soft, #0d99ff26), 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / .5); }

components.name: Switch
components.description: 28x16 pill; deep blue on, strong hairline off.
components.css: .ds-switch { position:relative; width:28px; height:16px; padding:0; border:0; border-radius:9999px; background:var(--color-line-strong, #4a4a4a); cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 150ms; } .ds-switch[aria-checked=true] { background:var(--color-accent-strong, #0a6fcc); } .ds-switch span { position:absolute; top:2px; left:2px; width:12px; height:12px; border-radius:50%; background:#fff; transition:transform 150ms; } .ds-switch[aria-checked=true] span { transform:translateX(12px); } .ds-switch:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--color-accent, #0d99ff); outline-offset:1px; }

components.name: Structure Tree
components.description: 28px rows with faint icons and tabular metadata; selection is a blue wash.
components.html: Stade
components.css: .ds-tree { width:224px; padding:0 8px; background:var(--color-panel, #2c2c2c); font-family:Inter, ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; } .ds-tree-group { padding:16px 8px 4px; font-size:11px; font-weight:500; color:var(--color-ink-faint, #9a9a9a); } .ds-tree-row { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; width:100%; height:28px; padding:0 8px; border:0; border-radius:4px; background:transparent; color:var(--color-ink, #e6e6e6); font-size:12px; text-align:left; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 100ms; } .ds-tree-row svg { color:var(--color-ink-faint, #9a9a9a); } .ds-tree-row span { flex:1; } .ds-tree-row em { font-style:normal; font-size:11px; color:var(--color-ink-faint, #9a9a9a); font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; } .ds-tree-row:hover { background:var(--color-hover, #333333); } .ds-tree-row.is-active { background:var(--color-accent-soft, #0d99ff26); } .ds-tree-row.is-active svg { color:var(--color-accent-ink, #5cb8ff); } .ds-tree-child { padding-left:32px; } .ds-tree-row:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--color-accent, #0d99ff); outline-offset:1px; }

components.name: Metric Strip
components.description: Signature: hairline-divided live metrics; signed blue deltas flash, hold and fade.
components.css: .ds-metrics { display:inline-flex; margin:0; border-radius:6px; background:rgb(44 44 44 / .95); border:1px solid var(--color-line, #3a3a3a); font-family:Inter, ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; } .ds-metrics > div { min-width:112px; padding:8px 12px; border-right:1px solid var(--color-line, #3a3a3a); } .ds-metrics > div:last-child { border-right:0; } .ds-metrics dt { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; gap:8px; font-size:11px; color:var(--color-ink-faint, #9a9a9a); } .ds-metrics dd { margin:0; font-size:13px; font-weight:500; color:var(--color-ink, #e6e6e6); font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; } .ds-metrics small { margin-left:2px; font-size:11px; font-weight:400; color:var(--color-ink-muted, #b8b8b8); } .ds-delta { font-weight:500; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; color:var(--color-accent-ink, #5cb8ff); animation:ds-delta 1800ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) infinite; } @keyframes ds-delta { 0% { opacity:0; transform:translateY(3px); } 12%, 70% { opacity:1; transform:none; } 100% { opacity:0; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-delta { animation:none; } }

components.name: Export Menu
components.description: Floating popover with the system's only ambient shadow; hovered row fills deep blue.
components.css: .ds-menu { width:288px; padding:4px; border-radius:6px; background:var(--color-panel, #2c2c2c); border:1px solid var(--color-line, #3a3a3a); box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgb(0 0 0 / .45); font-family:Inter, ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; } .ds-menu-item { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; width:100%; height:36px; padding:0 8px; border:0; border-radius:4px; background:transparent; text-align:left; cursor:pointer; } .ds-menu-item span { flex:1; font-size:12px; color:var(--color-ink, #e6e6e6); } .ds-menu-item em { font-style:normal; font-size:11px; color:var(--color-ink-faint, #9a9a9a); } .ds-menu-item:hover, .ds-menu-item:focus-visible { background:var(--color-accent-strong, #0a6fcc); outline:none; } .ds-menu-item:hover span, .ds-menu-item:focus-visible span { color:#fff; } .ds-menu-item:hover em, .ds-menu-item:focus-visible em { color:rgb(255 255 255 / .8); }

narrative.overview:
StadiumForge's chrome is a category-standard design-tool editor executed without irony, with Figma's craft level as the bar. A near-black neutral ground, three tonal grey steps, hairline dividers and one blue do all the work, so the 3D stadium in the centre is the only thing on screen with colour and spectacle. The interface is a workbench around the model: a structure tree on the left, the viewport filling the centre, a contextual inspector on the right, a slim top bar above.

Density is high and calm. Type sits at 11 to 13px, controls sit on 28px rows, and numbers are always tabular and French-formatted (fr-FR: narrow-space thousands, comma decimals). Feedback is carried by value, not by colour: when a parameter changes, the metric strip flashes a signed delta in blue, holds it, then lets it fade.

The world is dark only. Depth comes from tonal layering, not shadow; shadows exist only where something genuinely floats above the work (popovers, the mobile inspector drawer).
keyCharacteristics: Dark-only neutral greys; one blue family for selection, focus, sliders and the primary action.
Inter at 11/12/13px, weights 400/500/600, tabular numerals, `cv11` and `ss01` on.
28px control rows, 4px radii, 1px dividers, no gradients.
Flat surfaces; shadow only on floating layers.
Signed blue deltas as the signature feedback; red and amber stay out of ordinary feedback.

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: Blue is the only hue in the chrome. Bright blue marks; deep blue fills under white text; the wash selects; the ink speaks. Never swap their jobs.

rules.name: The No Scoreboard Rule
rules.body: Metric changes are never green or red. A delta is Signal Blue Ink with an explicit sign (+ or the true minus −); red and amber are kept for warnings and destruction.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every displayed number uses tabular numerals and `toLocaleString('fr-FR')`: "69 892", "75,1 m", "~416,8 M€". Typed entries accept comma decimals.

rules.name: The Three Sizes Rule
rules.body: Chrome text is 11, 12 or 13px. Nothing larger appears in the editor chrome.

rules.name: The Floating-Only Rule
rules.body: A shadow means "this sits above the work". Panels, cards, buttons and the metric strip get none.

dos: Do use Selection Blue for marks and Deep Action Blue for any fill carrying white text.
Do format every number with fr-FR and tabular numerals, and sign every delta.
Do keep controls on 28px rows with 4px corners and 1px borders.
Do separate zones and sections with Hairline dividers and tonal steps.
Do tuck expert parameters into a collapsed "Avancé" section.
donts: Don't colour metric changes green or red; deltas are Signal Blue Ink.
Don't use Warning Amber or Danger Coral outside warnings and destructive actions.
Don't add shadows to panels, buttons, cards or the metric strip; shadow is for popovers and the overlay drawer only.
Don't use gradients, a light theme, or text larger than 13px in the chrome.
Don't put white text on Selection Blue; it fails contrast.
Don't lighten Faint or Muted Ink back below their current values.
